# Plugin ideas and features

Keep this simple. This file is the plugin's living list of ideas, planned work,
currently supported behavior, and known gaps. It should be readable enough that
a human or agent can tell what exists, what is proposed, and what is not covered.

## Supported behavior

List the behavior this plugin actually provides today.

- behavior A
- behavior B
- behavior C

For each supported behavior, prefer a one-line description plus where it is
documented and proven.

## Planned and proposed ideas

List ideas that are deliberately not implemented yet, or only partially covered.

- idea A — short note on scope
- idea B — short note on scope

Mark intent when it matters: experimental, planned, deferred, rejected.

## Gaps and known limits

List the behavior this plugin does not provide, or only provides partially.

- gap A — how it fails or what is left out
- gap B — how it fails or what is left out

Do not hide this section. If a plugin cannot do something, say so plainly.

## Status convention

If a feature has a status table elsewhere, link it here. Otherwise keep this
file as the single readable summary.

## Rule

Do not let important ideas live only in the issue tracker, PR description, or
chat. If it affects what the plugin should do, record it here in plain language.
